chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) at the time of marching towards Syria
It was said: Indeed, he delivered it while he was at An-Nakheelah, departing from Kufa towards Siffin:

key_terms.النَّخِيلَةِ: An-Nakheelah, a location between Kufa and Siffin
key_terms.صَفِّينَ: Siffin, the site of the Battle of Siffin

ai.seo_question: Where did Imam Ali deliver his sermon before marching to Siffin?
ai.summary: This header situates the sermon within the pivotal prelude to the Battle of Siffin, highlighting An-Nakheelah as the strategic staging ground where Imam Ali (AS) addressed his troops before engaging Muawiyah’s forces. The mention of 'marching towards Syria' underscores the geopolitical tension of the era, framing the sermon not merely as religious exhortation but as a political and military directive to consolidate the Muslim community against internal dissent.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Delivered at the time of marching towards Syria.
